items.description: Internal frost-burst fitting repair incl. thermal-imaging leak detection
items.rationale: Covered under 2.4.4/7.1.9 (frost fracture of fitting, labour, consumables, one attendance) and 2.4.6/5.2.2 leak location (cap EUR 2,500 not reached). Lump sum prices covered work (7.1.12); fair market price for small fitting repair plus thermal imaging.

items.description: Exterior facade frost damage repair (re-plaster and repaint)
items.rationale: Plaster failed under outdoor cold, i.e. frost from without; optional peril 2.1(d) not stated as agreed, so 3.5(a)-(c) and 2.6.4 exclude the whole combined line (7.1.13). No evidence that escaping water reached the facade (2.4.3).
